Game Overview

In Fatty Ken 2, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the exhilarating world of Fatty Ken 2, where you guide a determined bodybuilder through vibrant 2D landscapes. Collect dumbbells, double jump over perilous obstacles, and outsmart flying foes across eight escalating levels. Each challenge demands patience and precision, ensuring a thrilling, action-packed platforming adventure.
